answer: Graduated reward vesting resists sybils: coins an identity earns vest linearly over many epochs, and any unvested balance is forfeited if that identity later fails an audit, so value cannot be grabbed and run. A farm mass-creating fakes to harvest emissions holds only a thin shale-layer of vested coin at first; the rest stays locked, a signal of future good behavior rather than cash. To realize earnings each fake must survive the whole vesting window clean, so an attacker caught at any point loses the copper still in escrow — hit-and-run extraction yields almost nothing.
